Summary statistics for counties in archetype A1. Bolded cluster means are significantly different from the study area mean (p < 0.05). A selection of urbanicity statistics are reported (all commute types used by >10% of a county's workforce) as there were very many (25) commute type possibilities in the study area, and means are not reported as they were not representative of the overall data spread.

:::

### A2

```{r}
#| include: false
#| label: "A2 data"

a2 <- clust_dat[["Actors"]] %>%
  filter(cluster == "A2")

a2_means <- a2 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "input_data_value") %>%
  group_by(input_data_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            median = median(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            min = min(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            max = max(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(var_name_clean = factor(input_data_name,
                                 levels = c("pop_per_acre", "perc_pop_change", "emply_pc1", "emply_pc2", "emply_pc3", "perc_retired", "avg_age", "med_income_in_2020_USD", "unemployment_rate", "High.school", "Bachelors", "races_PC1", "perc_hispanic", "tenure_pc1", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "num_hired", "ruca_proxy_pc1", "ruca_proxy_pc2"),
                                 labels = c("Population Density", "Population Change", "Employment Sectors (PC1)", "Employment Sectors (PC2)", "Employment Sectors (PC3)", "Retirees", "Average Age", "Median Income", "Unemployment Rate", "Residents with High School Education", "Residents with Bachelor's", "Racial Composition (PC1)", "Hispanic Residents", "Full Owned Farms", "Farms with Net Loss", "Hired Ag Workers", "Urbanicity (PC1)", "Urbanicity (PC2)"))) %>%
  arrange(var_name_clean) %>%
  relocate(var_name_clean, .before = input_data_name) %>%
  select(-input_data_name)

###############
# get employment raw data
emply_a2 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/employment_industries.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a2[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "industry",
               values_to = "perc_workers")

###############
# racial composition
races_a2 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/races_all.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a2[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "race",
               values_to = "perc")

###############
# farm tenure
tenure_a2 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/farm_own_perc.csv") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)-2) %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a2[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "tenure",
               values_to = "perc")

###############
# urbanicity
urb_a2 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/commutes_all.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a2[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "commut_type",
               values_to = "perc")
```

The counties in A2 are Adams, Butte, Camas, Clark, Fremont, Gooding, Jefferson, Lincoln, Minidoka, Owyhee, Power, Gem (1990), Teton (1990), and Washington (1990).

### A3

```{r}
#| include: false
#| label: "A3 data"

a3 <- clust_dat[["Actors"]] %>%
  filter(cluster == "A3")

a3_means <- a3 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "input_data_value") %>%
  group_by(input_data_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            median = median(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            min = min(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            max = max(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(var_name_clean = factor(input_data_name,
                                 levels = c("pop_per_acre", "perc_pop_change", "emply_pc1", "emply_pc2", "emply_pc3", "perc_retired", "avg_age", "med_income_in_2020_USD", "unemployment_rate", "High.school", "Bachelors", "races_PC1", "perc_hispanic", "tenure_pc1", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "num_hired", "ruca_proxy_pc1", "ruca_proxy_pc2"),
                                 labels = c("Population Density", "Population Change", "Employment Sectors (PC1)", "Employment Sectors (PC2)", "Employment Sectors (PC3)", "Retirees", "Average Age", "Median Income", "Unemployment Rate", "Residents with High School Education", "Residents with Bachelor's", "Racial Composition (PC1)", "Hispanic Residents", "Full Owned Farms", "Farms with Net Loss", "Hired Ag Workers", "Urbanicity (PC1)", "Urbanicity (PC2)"))) %>%
  arrange(var_name_clean) %>%
  relocate(var_name_clean, .before = input_data_name) %>%
  select(-input_data_name)

###############
# get employment raw data
emply_a3 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/employment_industries.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a3[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "industry",
               values_to = "perc_workers")

###############
# racial composition
races_a3 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/races_all.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a3[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "race",
               values_to = "perc")

###############
# farm tenure
tenure_a3 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/farm_own_perc.csv") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)-2) %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a3[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "tenure",

###############
# urbanicity

  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a3[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "commut_type",
               values_to = "perc")
```

The counties in A3 are Bannock, Bonneville, Twin Falls, Bingham (2010-2020), Elmore (2010-2020), and Jerome (2020).

A selection of urbanicity statistics are reported (all commute types used by >10% of a county's workforce) as there were very many (25) commute type possibilities in the study area. All counties in A4 are "small town" counties (contain an urban area with a population 5,000-9,999).
